collectionNote: Research-only aggregate summaries collected from the publicly reachable Fishbrain GraphQL endpoint with unauthenticated, read-only queries. These are discovery candidates, not verified biological records and are not emitted into the Trout app until independently checked against reusable agency or scientific sources.
